context: Two friends chat over coffee about a strange encounter downtown
purpose: Teach: 出会う/クルマ/缶/ボックス/ライター/徒歩/奇妙/とうとう

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いてよ。昨日、駅から徒歩で帰る途中に、すごく奇妙な人に出会うことがあったの。
lines.en: Hey, listen. Yesterday, walking home from the station, I happened to run into a really strange person.
lines.style: Warm conversational opener, leaning in with excitement to share a story.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、奇妙ってどんなふうに?やだ、ちょっとドキドキするじゃない。
lines.en: Eh, strange how? Oh my, that's making my heart race a little.
lines.style: Soft dreamy curiosity, voice rising with romantic anticipation and intrigue.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 黒いクルマの横で、空き缶を集めてる男の人がいてね、手にはなぜかライターを持ってたの。
lines.en: There was a guy collecting empty cans beside a black car, and for some reason he was holding a lighter.
lines.style: Animated storyteller pacing, painting the scene with quick visual details.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ライター?火、つけようとしてたのかな。なんだか映画のワンシーンみたい。
lines.en: A lighter? Was he trying to light something? It sounds like a scene from a movie.
lines.style: Wistful and imaginative, drifting into cinematic fantasy with breathy wonder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがね、近くに大きな段ボールのボックスがあって、その中をずっと覗き込んでたんだよ。
lines.en: Here's the thing, there was a big cardboard box nearby, and he kept peering inside it the whole time.
lines.style: Lowered conspiratorial tone, building suspense with a slow deliberate cadence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: こわっ。中身、なんだったの?気になって眠れなくなりそう。
lines.en: Scary! What was inside? I feel like I won't be able to sleep from curiosity.
lines.style: Dramatic gasp followed by playful melodrama, hands probably on her cheeks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私も気になって、とうとう声をかけちゃった。そしたら、迷子の子猫を保護してたんだって。
lines.en: I got so curious that I finally called out to him. Turns out he was rescuing a lost kitten.
lines.style: Relieved laugh creeping in, delivering the twist with a soft warm chuckle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: なんだ、いい人だったんじゃない!その話、もっと詳しく聞かせて。コーヒーおかわりするね。
lines.en: Aw, he was a good person after all! Tell me more in detail, I'm getting a coffee refill.
lines.style: Bright relieved giggle, settling in cozily for a longer chat session.
